title.en: Small business: MSME classification and role in India
title.kn: ಸಣ್ಣ ಉದ್ಯಮ: ಎಂಎಸ್‌ಎಂಇ ವರ್ಗೀಕರಣ ಮತ್ತು ಭಾರತದಲ್ಲಿ ಪಾತ್ರ

hook.en: The agarbatti units of Mysuru, the silk looms of Ramanagara and the cashew units of Mangaluru are all small businesses. Together they employ lakhs of people.

objectives.en: Classify enterprises as micro, small or medium
Explain the role of small business in India
Explain the role of small business in rural India

narration.en: The agarbatti units of Mysuru, the silk looms of Ramanagara and the cashew units of Mangaluru are all small businesses. Together they employ lakhs of people.
narration.kn: ಮೈಸೂರಿನ ಅಗರಬತ್ತಿ ಘಟಕಗಳು, ರಾಮನಗರದ ರೇಷ್ಮೆ ಮಗ್ಗಗಳು, ಮಂಗಳೂರಿನ ಗೋಡಂಬಿ ಘಟಕಗಳು ಎಲ್ಲವೂ ಸಣ್ಣ ಉದ್ಯಮಗಳು. ಒಟ್ಟಾಗಿ ಲಕ್ಷಾಂತರ ಜನರಿಗೆ ಉದ್ಯೋಗ ನೀಡುತ್ತವೆ.

body.en: Under the MSMED Act, 2006, as revised in 2020, enterprises are classified on composite criteria: investment in plant and machinery or equipment AND annual turnover. 2020 limits: micro, investment up to ₹1 crore and turnover up to ₹5 crore; small, up to ₹10 crore and ₹50 crore; medium, up to ₹50 crore and ₹250 crore. The limits were raised again from April 2025 (micro ₹2.5 crore and ₹10 crore; small ₹25 crore and ₹100 crore; medium ₹125 crore and ₹500 crore). An enterprise that crosses either limit moves to the next category.
body.kn: ಸ್ಥಾವರ ಮತ್ತು ಯಂತ್ರೋಪಕರಣಗಳಲ್ಲಿನ ಹೂಡಿಕೆ ಹಾಗೂ ವಾರ್ಷಿಕ ವಹಿವಾಟು ಎರಡನ್ನೂ ಬಳಸಿ ಉದ್ಯಮಗಳನ್ನು ಸೂಕ್ಷ್ಮ, ಸಣ್ಣ ಅಥವಾ ಮಧ್ಯಮ ಎಂದು ವರ್ಗೀಕರಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: Cross either limit: move up a category

narration.en: Enterprises are classified as micro, small or medium using both investment in plant and machinery and annual turnover.
narration.kn: ಸ್ಥಾವರ ಮತ್ತು ಯಂತ್ರೋಪಕರಣಗಳಲ್ಲಿನ ಹೂಡಿಕೆ ಹಾಗೂ ವಾರ್ಷಿಕ ವಹಿವಾಟು ಎರಡನ್ನೂ ಬಳಸಿ ಉದ್ಯಮಗಳನ್ನು ಸೂಕ್ಷ್ಮ, ಸಣ್ಣ ಅಥವಾ ಮಧ್ಯಮ ಎಂದು ವರ್ಗೀಕರಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

narration.en: MSMEs are classified on two tests together: investment in plant and machinery, and annual turnover.

say.en: MSMEs are classified on two tests together: investment in plant and machinery, and annual turnover.
Small: up to 10 crore investment and 50 crore turnover. Medium: up to 50 and 250 crore.
From April 2025 the limits were raised to 2.5 and 10, 25 and 100, and 125 and 500 crore.
Crossing either limit moves a unit up. Investment 8 crore with turnover 60 crore is medium under the 2020 limits, because turnover is above 50.

text.en: Invest ₹8 cr: small; turnover ₹60 cr: medium

say.en: Small units matter: second largest employer after agriculture, big exporters, and engines of rural and balanced growth.

title.en: Role of small business in India and rural India

body.en: Small industries are the second largest employer in India after agriculture. They produce a wide variety of goods, contribute substantially to exports, use local resources and help balanced regional development by setting up in backward areas. They offer self-employment, need little capital, and allow quick decisions and personal contact with customers. In rural India, cottage and village industries give alternative employment to farm families, check migration to cities, reduce poverty and use local skills and raw materials.
body.kn: ಸಣ್ಣ ಉದ್ಯಮಗಳು ಕೃಷಿಯ ನಂತರ ಭಾರತದ ಅತಿದೊಡ್ಡ ಉದ್ಯೋಗದಾತ; ಹಳ್ಳಿಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಹಿಂದುಳಿದ ಪ್ರದೇಶಗಳಿಗೆ ಉದ್ಯೋಗ ಹರಡುತ್ತವೆ.

narration.en: Small businesses are India's largest employer after agriculture and spread jobs to villages and backward regions.
narration.kn: ಸಣ್ಣ ಉದ್ಯಮಗಳು ಕೃಷಿಯ ನಂತರ ಭಾರತದ ಅತಿದೊಡ್ಡ ಉದ್ಯೋಗದಾತ; ಹಳ್ಳಿಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಹಿಂದುಳಿದ ಪ್ರದೇಶಗಳಿಗೆ ಉದ್ಯೋಗ ಹರಡುತ್ತವೆ.

problem.en: Classify three units (use either the 2020 or the 2025 limits; the answer is the same): Unit P has ₹80 lakh in machinery and ₹4 crore turnover. Unit Q has ₹8 crore in machinery and ₹40 crore turnover. Unit R has ₹30 crore in machinery and ₹200 crore turnover.

steps.en: P: ₹0.8 crore ≤ ₹1 crore and ₹4 crore ≤ ₹5 crore, within micro limits: micro.
Q: ₹8 crore exceeds the micro limits but is within small (₹8 ≤ 10 crore, ₹40 ≤ 50 crore): small.
R: ₹30 crore investment exceeds the small limit; ₹30 ≤ 50 crore and ₹200 ≤ 250 crore: medium.
Under the 2025 limits P (0.8 ≤ 2.5, 4 ≤ 10) is micro, Q (8 ≤ 25, 40 ≤ 100) is small, R (30 > 25, 200 ≤ 500) is medium.

answer.en: P is micro, Q is small, R is medium.

points.en: 2020 limits: micro ₹1/5 crore, small ₹10/50 crore, medium ₹50/250 crore.
Small business: largest employer after agriculture, aids balanced growth.
points.kn: ಸಣ್ಣ ಉದ್ಯಮ: ಕೃಷಿಯ ನಂತರ ಅತಿದೊಡ್ಡ ಉದ್ಯೋಗದಾತ, ಸಮತೋಲಿತ ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆಗೆ ನೆರವು.

points.en: In villages it gives alternative jobs and checks migration.
points.kn: ಹಳ್ಳಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಪರ್ಯಾಯ ಉದ್ಯೋಗ ನೀಡಿ ವಲಸೆ ತಡೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.

homework.en: Find two small industries in your district and note what they produce.

narration.en: Recap. MSME: classified by investment AND turnover. 2020 limits: micro ₹1/5 crore, small ₹10/50 crore, medium ₹50/250 crore. Small business: largest employer after agriculture, aids balanced growth. In villages it gives alternative jobs and checks migration.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಎಂಎಸ್‌ಎಂಇ: ಹೂಡಿಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ವಹಿವಾಟು ಎರಡರ ಆಧಾರದ ಮೇಲೆ ವರ್ಗೀಕರಣ. 2020 ಮಿತಿಗಳು: ಸೂಕ್ಷ್ಮ ₹1/5 ಕೋಟಿ, ಸಣ್ಣ ₹10/50 ಕೋಟಿ, ಮಧ್ಯಮ ₹50/250 ಕೋಟಿ. ಸಣ್ಣ ಉದ್ಯಮ: ಕೃಷಿಯ ನಂತರ ಅತಿದೊಡ್ಡ ಉದ್ಯೋಗದಾತ, ಸಮತೋಲಿತ ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆಗೆ ನೆರವು. ಹಳ್ಳಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಪರ್ಯಾಯ ಉದ್ಯೋಗ ನೀಡಿ ವಲಸೆ ತಡೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.
